text:
I turned the camera around slowly.

On the north shore, wrapped in fog, there was a small town. Empty streets, a church, a row of houses. The town from SALTMARSH.

Out in the middle, on the frozen part of the water, there was an ice fishing hut with a hole cut in the floor. STILLWATER.

By the old rail bridge to the east there was a signal box on stilts, with one lamp in the window. SIGNALMAN.

Every game Dead Pixel ever made was built on the same map. The same lake, seen from different places. Merrow Lake.
